claim: If you use Amazon VPC to host your AWS resources, you can create a private connection between your VPC and SNS, and with this connection you can publish messages to SNS topics without sending them through the public internet.

evidence.quote: If you use Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) to host your AWS resources, you can create a private connection between your VPC and Amazon SNS. With this connection, you can publish messages to your Amazon SNS topics without sending them through the public internet.
